name: Half-timbered wall crossing
description: A crossing of half-timbered village house wall on a low fieldstone plinth, matching wall_timber_straight: a square dark oak post over the junction and arms running 0.75 m to +x, -x, +y and -y, each a stone plinth, an oak sill, warm off-white lime plaster and the top plate, so straight sections join at the tile edge. The `_low` variant is a cutaway wall (about 1.4 m) for roofless village buildings. `_rubble` and `_rubble_2` (two layouts, each also `_low`) build the plinth in the rubble stone of the stone walls: rounded stones of mixed sizes with dark recessed joints.
